A burst of failed logins, which usually means credential stuffing against known addresses.

**First response:** query audit_logs for the source IPs and whether failures cluster on one account (targeted) or many (spray). The rate limiter should already be throttling; if it is not, check whether Redis is reachable — the limiter falls back to per-process in-memory state and effectively fails open across restarts (F-024).
